problem.title: Realization of Persistence Pairings by Filtration Functions
problem.statement: Let $P$ be a persistence pairing on a filtered simplicial complex $K$, let $V_P$ be its associated discrete gradient vector field, and let $P_{V_P,f}$ be the persistence pairing induced by an integer-valued filtration function $f$. Is there a choice of $f$ for which $P_{V_P,f}=P$?
problem.background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

adjacent_prior_problem.title: Gradient-Path Uniqueness in Persistence Pairings
adjacent_prior_problem.statement: Let $K$ be a filtered simplicial complex, let $P$ be a persistence pairing on $K$, and let $V_P$ be the discrete vector field formed from persistence pairs in which one simplex is a face of the other. If $\{\sigma,\tau\}$ is a persistence pair and $\sigma$ is not a face of $\tau$, is there exactly one gradient path from $\tau$ to $\sigma$ in $V_P$?
adjacent_prior_problem.background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Computational Algebraic Topology (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2008/29, pp. 1603--1654](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2008/29)
